definitions.full: H8276. sarag [ שָׂרַג ] verb Pu`al be intertwined (Talmud סָרַג Pi`el enmesh, weave around ; Aramaic intertwine, involve , סְרַג entwine ; Arabic set in order, join, weave, mix ); — Imperfect 3masculine plural יְשׂרָ֑גוּ Job 40:17 are intertwined (of sinews of hippopotamus). Hithpa`el Imperfect 3masculine plural יִשְׂתָּֽרְגוּ Lam 1:14 they intertwine themselves (figurative of מְּשְׁעַי ).
